# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
get_property(vendors GLOBAL PROPERTY EXR_VENDOR_TARGETS)
list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES vendors)
set(exr_dependency_config "# Private static dependencies; no public headers required.\n")
if(UNIX)
  string(APPEND exr_dependency_config "include(CMakeFindDependencyMacro)\nfind_dependency(Threads)\n")
endif()
foreach(vendor IN LISTS vendors)
  get_target_property(vendor_files ${vendor} EXR_VENDOR_FILES)
  if(NOT vendor_files)
    set(vendor_files ${vendor})
  endif()
  set(vendor_links "")
  foreach(file IN LISTS vendor_files)
    set(filename "${CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_PREFIX}exr_vendor_${file}${CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}")
    install(FILES $<TARGET_FILE:${file}> DESTINATION lib/exreader RENAME "${filename}")
    string(APPEND exr_dependency_config "if(NOT TARGET EXReader::vendor_file_${file})\n  add_library(EXReader::vendor_file_${file} STATIC IMPORTED)\n  set_target_properties(EXReader::vendor_file_${file} PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION \"\${PACKAGE_PREFIX_DIR}/lib/exreader/${filename}\")\n")
    if(UNIX)
      string(APPEND exr_dependency_config "  set_property(TARGET EXReader::vendor_file_${file} PROPERTY INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES \"Threads::Threads;m;${CMAKE_DL_LIBS}\")\n")
    endif()
    string(APPEND exr_dependency_config "endif()\n")
    list(APPEND vendor_links "EXReader::vendor_file_${file}")
  endforeach()
  string(APPEND exr_dependency_config "if(NOT TARGET EXReader::vendor_${vendor})\n  add_library(EXReader::vendor_${vendor} INTERFACE IMPORTED)\n  set_property(TARGET EXReader::vendor_${vendor} PROPERTY INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES \"${vendor_links}\")\nendif()\n")
endforeach()
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/EXReaderDependencies.cmake" "${exr_dependency_config}")
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/EXReaderDependencies.cmake" DESTINATION lib/cmake/EXReader)
if(EXR_ENABLE_PDF AND EXR_ENABLE_PDF_JPX)
  install(FILES ${openjpeg_SOURCE_DIR}/LICENSE DESTINATION share/exreader/licenses/openjpeg)
endif()

@PACKAGE_INIT@
set(EXReader_VERSION "@PROJECT_VERSION@")
set(EXReader_ABI_VERSION @EXR_ABI_VERSION@)
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/EXReaderDependencies.cmake")
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/EXReaderTargets.cmake")
foreach(component core pdf pdf_edit audio library textindex)
  if(TARGET EXReader::exr_${component})
    set(EXReader_${component}_FOUND TRUE)
    get_target_property(EXReader_${component}_VERSION EXReader::exr_${component} EXR_COMPONENT_VERSION)
  else()
    set(EXReader_${component}_FOUND FALSE)
  endif()
endforeach()
check_required_components(EXReader)

@PACKAGE_INIT@
include(CMakeFindDependencyMacro)
find_dependency(Threads)
# Exact dependency hook; independent of old builders' CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH overrides.
set(_hash_prefix "${READER_ORIGINAL_HASH_PREFIX}")
set(_hash_env "$ENV{EXREADER_ORIGINAL_HASH_PREFIX}")
if(NOT _hash_prefix)
  set(_hash_prefix "${_hash_env}")
endif()
if(NOT IS_ABSOLUTE "${_hash_prefix}" OR NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${_hash_prefix}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set READER_ORIGINAL_HASH_PREFIX or EXREADER_ORIGINAL_HASH_PREFIX to the installed OPDSHash prefix")
endif()
file(REAL_PATH "${_hash_prefix}" _hash_real)
if(NOT "${_hash_prefix}" STREQUAL "${_hash_real}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Original hash prefix must be canonical")
endif()
if(_hash_env)
  file(REAL_PATH "${_hash_env}" _hash_env_real)
  if(NOT IS_ABSOLUTE "${_hash_env}" OR NOT "${_hash_env}" STREQUAL "${_hash_env_real}" OR
      NOT "${_hash_env_real}" STREQUAL "${_hash_real}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Conflicting original hash prefix selectors")
  endif()
endif()
set(_hash_config "${_hash_real}/lib/cmake/EXReaderOPDSHash")
if(DEFINED EXReaderOPDSHash_DIR AND NOT "${EXReaderOPDSHash_DIR}" STREQUAL "${_hash_config}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Foreign cached OPDSHash package directory")
endif()
find_dependency(EXReaderOPDSHash 0.1.0 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED
  PATHS "${_hash_config}" NO_DEFAULT_PATH NO_CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH)
if(NOT "${EXReaderOPDSHash_DIR}" STREQUAL "${_hash_config}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Original hash package discovery escaped the selected prefix")
endif()
exreader_opds_hash_validate("${_hash_real}")
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/EXReaderProductCatalogTargets.cmake")
